title: Konqraft
description: A modpack that prioritizes smooth performance, and animations.
body:
A modpack that prioritizes smooth performance, and animations This modpack is designed for players who want the best balance between smooth performance and visually appealing animations. Instead of overwhelming the game with heavy content mods, it focuses on optimizing the overall experience, ensuring that gameplay remains fluid even on mid-range systems. Performance-enhancing mods handle memory management, chunk loading, and rendering improvements so that the game runs at higher frame rates with fewer stutters. Alongside these optimizations, carefully chosen animation and visual enhancement mods bring the world to life without sacrificing speed.

Character movement, combat, and interactions feel more natural thanks to smoother animation systems that refine everything from walking to tool usage. Subtle visual details, like swaying foliage or more dynamic item transitions, add depth without being resource-heavy. Lightweight shaders or minimalistic visual tweaks are also included to give the world a polished look while maintaining consistent performance.

The goal of this pack is not to overwhelm with excessive additions, but to provide a streamlined experience that looks good and runs even better. Whether exploring vast landscapes, engaging in combat, or building intricate structures, this modpack ensures you get fluid animations and optimized gameplay perfect for players who value both style and performance.
